column1: # Time budgets for .devcontainer/scripts/perf-timings.sh against the --perf seed
#   budget  seconds, best of 3 runs; xfail:<seconds> = known problem, reported but not counted,
#           XPASS once it answers within those seconds
#   backend sql, api or any (api = the API backend instances 8083-8085)
#   key     admin (the fixture test key) or owner (perf_owner, X-API-Key perf-owner-key)
#   path    API v2 path; {big} is big.perf.test's zone id
#   note    why the budget is what it is
# Budgets are 3x or more the PostgreSQL baseline of 2026-10-27, so a failure means a real slowdown.
